snapshot.title: PLC-02 Backup Missing — 03/2025 Revision Not Found

fields.subject: FW: PLC-02 Backup Missing — 03/2025 Revision Not Found
fields.note: This came up during a routine backup audit. The 08/2025 flow-pacing revision for PLC-02 was not found in the backup archive. The only copy is on PLC-02 itself and on Jared Molina’s personal laptop (MBW-LAP-09). The Kessler Controls window for the 08/2025 update was closed on 03/2025. No backup exists in the system. The current program on PLC-02 does not contain the 08/2025 update. This is a critical risk: if PLC-02 fails, the system will not pace flow properly during future surges. I recommend immediate documentation and a formal risk report to the City Manager.
fields.signature:
Priya Nandakumar
SCADA / IT Security Manager
